QuestInfo.name: [Omega Sector] M-Force Go!
QuestInfo.0: Dr. Kim allowed the M-Forcers to combine their Mesodizers into Mesotron-X. But what's this? Even the Mesotron has shrunk!
QuestInfo.1: Dr. Kim has a plan to return the M-Forcers to their original size, which required infiltrating an alien Mothership. Head to Boswell Field 1 with the others.
QuestInfo.2: Dr. Kim has a plan to return the M-Forcers to their original size, which required infiltrating an alien Mothership. You headed to Boswell Field 1 with the mini M-Forcers.

0.msg: There's work to be done at Boswell Field 1!
